item.title: Neural Isomorphic Fields: A Transformer-based Algebraic Numerical Embedding
item.description: Neural network models often face challenges when processing very small or very large numbers due to issues such as overflow, underflow, and unstable output variations. To mitigate these problems, we propose using embedding vectors for numbers instead of directly using their raw values.

item.title: General-Purpose Decision Models for AI Configuration Tuning
item.description: AI configuration tuning searches for settings that improve the performance of AI systems under a limited budget. Existing tuners use different sampling and search policies, making the choice of decision strategy central to both tuning quality and cost.

item.description: Quantum chemistry calculations on a fault-tolerant quantum computer usually require many $\text{T}$ gates. This cost depends on the simulation method and how precisely its rotations are implemented.

item.title: WAtcher: Watching Ahead for Safe Robotic Manipulation with Efficient World-Action Models
item.description: World-action models (WAMs) couple future imagination with action generation, but they execute every action chunk while ignoring the potential risk. To fill this gap, we present WAtcher, a safety-aware world-action framework in which the policy imagines the outcome of the candidate chunk before execution.

The locality of Union-Find (UF) decoding makes it a leading candidate for such a decoder in distributed hardware.
